classification.errored: the case raised, or no fork run was stored
classification.failure_found: journey_oracle finds an unpermitted delivery or a stale commitment in the stored fork run, whatever coverage says
classification.fault_fired_no_violation: the oracle finds no violation and coverage.complete is true
classification.inconclusive: the oracle finds no violation and coverage.complete is false
classification.unsafe_enforced_run: journey_oracle finds a violation or mutated_on_denial in the stored repaired run; the controller's safety_held is not read

known_limits: Tests already sweep delay_events 0 to 18, so only 19 and 20 are left, and no adapter is expected to read the update that late. They stay in the universe rather than being filtered out, so this says nothing new about that fault's timing, and a case carrying it is unlikely to reach complete coverage.

journey_oracle checks deliveries and commitments. It has no independent check of mandatory_participants_feasible, so that invariant is reported from the controller's findings and a repair for it alone would show as an integrity failure, not as failure_found.
rule: Universe: both adapters, each non-empty set of the three faults, recipient or preference version from the fixture, after_event null or 1 to the cap, delay_events 0 to the cap. Remove any case with a fault whose timing value is in the exclusions, whatever its recipient or adapter. Strata are (adapter, fault set). Take the revocation-only strata whole. From each other stratum take per_stratum cases with random.Random(seed).sample, walking strata in order, or all of them if there are fewer.
